title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-12 08:51:55 最新章节：第802章 你惹上事了
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
荷花池畔，古色古香的凉亭屹立。
一锦衣少年席地而坐在青石板铺设的亭边，其脸色苍白如纸，低眉敛目，沉浸在追思中。
沈算至今也想不明白，自己怎么就……穿越了？
追思间记忆碎片翻涌：
烈日下他挥汗如雨，埋头挖掘下水道预埋沟。
舞动的锄头，“铛”
的一声，震得其手发麻，这磕到硬物了。
他低头查看间，隐约看到一抹青色锈迹时，后脑勺猛得传来骤然的剧痛……
再睁眼之时，已然身在此世间。
“少爷……”
一声温和的呼唤，将他从锈迹斑斑的记忆中拉回现实。
沈算侧首，对来人挤出一个虚弱的笑容：“钟叔。”
钟宇，年约三十出头，圆脸微胖，一身素衣管家打扮，此刻正微欠着身，脸上满是关切的说：“少爷，您大病初愈，不宜久坐凉地吹风，还是回厅歇息吧？”
“无妨。”
沈算轻轻摇头，声音虽弱却是带着坚持说：“常言道久卧伤气，动则舒筋活络，日晒可驱寒补阳。”
“少爷高见，是属下愚钝了。”
钟宇恭敬道。
“钟叔过谦了。”
沈算摆手，切入正题：“我让你打听的事，可有消息？”
“回少爷，已有眉目。”

钟宇神色一正：“落霞城虽是大炎新设边城，但紧邻落霞山脉，鱼龙混杂，山中杀伐不断，破损的杀伐之器极易收购，数量应不成问题。”
“只是……”
他忧虑地看着沈算：“少爷您的身体……”
“钟叔，”
沈算打断他，眼神平静却带着一丝看透的疲惫说：“自‘眉开一线，诡柳虚象降临’的那刻起，我便知命不久矣。”
“受此诡柳虚象侵蚀，生机已如风中残烛。”
“可您族中尚有‘七阳丹’！
可镇压那诡柳诅咒与阴邪之气！”
钟宇急切的说。
沈算闻言眼中泛起一层不易察觉的微红，一股源自身体深处的强烈悲恸涌上心头。
其声悲戚的说：“双亲为求那七阳丹，已殒命黑水山脉……用命换来六枚七阳丹，换得我独立分支，迁来这落霞城经商。”
话至此，他深吸一口气，强压下翻腾的情绪，目光灼灼地看向钟宇说：“如今，丹仅余二。”
“钟叔，我已无退路，唯有……向死而生！”
“少爷！”
钟宇悲愤交加，“您尚有长辈在族中……”
“旁支子弟罢了。”
沈算声音透着彻骨的凉意：“沈氏乃商贾世家，利字当头。”
“自我决意携你们离族独立，结局便已注定。”
“留在族中？呵，不过是多苟延残喘几日，徒累你们一同入那死局。”
他疲惫地挥挥手，“此事……不必再提。”

“是少爷。”
钟宇强压心中的劝解。
“钟叔，你去办事吧。
收购残破的杀伐之器。
content_en:
An antique pavilion stands beside the lotus pond.
A young man in brocade clothes sat on the ground beside a pavilion paved with bluestones. His face was as pale as paper, his eyebrows lowered and his eyes narrowed, immersed in remembrance.
Shen Suan still can't figure out why he... traveled through time?
During the remembrance, memory fragments surged:
Under the scorching sun, he was sweating profusely and immersed himself in digging sewer trenches.
Dancing hoe, "dang"
The sound of the shock made his hand numb. He had hit something hard.
He lowered his head to examine the room, and when he vaguely saw a trace of blue rust, he felt a sudden sharp pain in the back of his head...
When I opened my eyes again, I was already in this world.
"Master..."
A gentle call brought him back to reality from his rusty memories.
Shen Suan tilted his head and gave the visitor a weak smile: "Uncle Zhong."
Zhong Yu, who is in his early thirties, has a round face and is slightly chubby. He is dressed as a housekeeper in plain clothes. He is leaning slightly at the moment. His face is full of concern and he says: "Master, you have just recovered from a serious illness. It is not suitable to sit in the cold for a long time and have a rest, right?"
"It doesn't matter."
Shen Suan shook his head gently, and said in a weak but insistent voice: "As the saying goes, lying down for a long time damages Qi, while moving relaxes the muscles and activates the collaterals, and exposure to the sun can dispel cold and replenish Yang."
"Young master, my subordinates are stupid."
Zhong Yu said respectfully.
"Uncle Zhong is too modest."
Shen Suan waved his hand and got to the point: "Do you have any news about what I asked you to inquire about?"
"Go back to the young master, I already have a clue."
Zhong Yu looked serious: "Although Luoxia City is a newly established border town in Dayan, it is close to the Luoxia Mountains, where fish and dragons are mixed, and killings are constant in the mountains. Broken killing weapons are easy to purchase, so the quantity should not be a problem."
"It's just..."
He looked at Shen Suan worriedly: "Master, your body..."
"Uncle Zhong,"
Shen Suan interrupted him, his eyes calm but with a hint of tiredness as he said: "From the moment when my eyebrows opened and the treacherous willow phantom descended, I knew that I was going to die soon."
"Eroded by this treacherous willow illusion, the vitality has been like a candle in the wind."
“But there is still a ‘Seven Yang Pill’ in your clan!
It can suppress the curse of the willow tree and the evil spirit! "
Zhong Yu said eagerly.
Hearing this, Shen Suan's eyes turned slightly red, and a strong sadness from deep within his body surged into his heart.
He said in a sad voice: "My parents died in the Blackwater Mountains in order to seek the Seven Sun Pills... They exchanged their lives for six Seven Sun Pills, and in exchange for my independent branch, I moved to Luoxia City to do business."
At this point, he took a deep breath, suppressed the turbulent emotions, looked at Zhong Yu with burning eyes and said: "Now, there are only two pills left."
"Uncle Zhong, I have no way out, I can only...live towards death!"
"Master!"
Zhong Yu was filled with grief and anger, "You still have elders in the clan..."
"Just a descendant of the branch."
Shen Suan's voice was filled with a bone-chilling chill: "The Shen family belongs to a family of merchants, and profit is their top priority."
"If I decide to lead you to leave the clan and become independent, the outcome is already doomed."
"Stay in the clan? Oh, it's just a matter of hanging on for a few more days, and you will end up in that dead end together."
He waved his hand tiredly, "This matter... doesn't need to be mentioned again."
"It's the young master."
Zhong Yu suppressed the persuasion in his heart.
"Uncle Zhong, go and do some work.
Acquire the broken killing weapon.
